data.body: Implementation complete after 2 attempts. Held-out strict/best-effort matrix: 83 passed, including five real competitors plus exactly one terminal sixth push, all 11 stable strict reasons, real module-CLI stderr/nonzero translation, no event/BRIDGE_ALERT, caller continuity, stash/pop, epoch, importer, and inline-write regressions. Mutation checks each went RED when removing the final push, adding a duplicate final push, or suppressing strict raises. make lint and make typecheck pass. make test initially exposed the worktree missing the newly pinned pytest-timeout dependency; after canonical make install it ran cleanly through 10% before being stopped to follow the operator instruction to push and rely on CI. Refactoring litmus: recovery behavior is separated along existing fetch/lock/dirty-merge seams; push.py is 555 LOC, below the 800 cap, and complexity increased=0.
